newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA T-BILL ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED, YIELD UP.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA T-BILL ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED, YIELD UP.

text.p: An issue of 1.44 trilion lei worth of three-month treasury bills was heavily oversubscribed on Tuesday, when 20 bidders entered a total 2.62 trillion lei for the finance ministry's offer, a central bank statement showed.

The T-bills bear an annual yield of 55 percent, up from 52 percent previously. The bids ranged from 38 to 75 percent. Some 1.18 billion lei went to commercial banks operating in Romania, including branches and subsidiaries of foreign banks, and 266.14 billion lei went to their corporate clients.
